info.title: API.SH: Roblox
info.description: The Roblox API from API.SH: public Roblox data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An experience's badges: name, description, icon, enabled, how many players earned it in total and in the past day, and the win rate. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/roblox-badges

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Roblox avatar shop, or open one item with `id`: name, description, item and asset type, creator, price in Robux, lowest price and lowest resale price, favourites, total quantity, limited flags, sale status, categories and bundled items. Paged with a cursor.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/roblox-catalog

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One catalog item id, e.g. `1028606` (Red Baseball Cap). Gives that item's detail.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), favorited, sales, updated, price_asc, price_desc or recent.

parameters.name: creator
parameters.description: Only items by this creator name, e.g. `Roblox`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Catalog category id, e.g. 1 all, 11 clothing, 12 accessories.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor: pass `next_cursor` from the previous answer.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Red Baseball Cap
example.description: This hat isn't worn out, it's well loved! Colored a bombastic red, with a stylish looking R that leaves no doubt which game you are playing.
example.creator: Roblox

get.description:
A Roblox experience (game) by place id or universe id: name, description, link, creator, players online now, visits, favourites, up and down votes and like ratio, max players per server, genre, price, created and updated dates, icon, thumbnails, social links and game passes with prices. With `include=servers` (one more read) also `servers`: public servers right now with server id, players, max players, frame rate and ping.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/roblox-game

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description: Place id, the number in roblox.com/games/<place_id> (2753915549 = Blox Fruits).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: servers: add the public servers list.

parameters.name: servers_limit
parameters.description: How many servers with include=servers: 10, 25 (default), 50 or 100.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A group's (community's) members with their role and rank, newest or oldest first, or only the members of one role. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

The public experiences a Roblox user created: universe id, place id, name, description, link, visits, players now, favourites, max players, genre, created and updated times. Paged with a cursor.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/roblox-user-games

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Roblox user id, e.g. `1` (Roblox). Or give `username`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: asc or desc by creation (default desc).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor: pass `next_cursor` from the previous answer.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
